_meta.format: Vertical 9:16 (1080 x 1920) for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, 15–20 seconds. Built from the idea’s vertical illustration (1000 x 1500) — no filming of a real setup (source document §5: slow zoom over the illustration, narration of the joke, the steps in 3 text cuts).
_meta.cutsRule: Exactly 3 on-screen text cuts, about 4–5 seconds each, taken only from the idea’s own materials and steps. On-screen text is an overlay; it is never drawn into the illustration.
_meta.safetyRule: When safetyOnScreen is not null, that exact text stays on screen (small lower band) for the whole video, or at least through every cut it relates to.
_meta.endCard: Last 2 seconds: site mark + “Full steps at the link in bio” (no shortened links; the bio link is the plain site address).
_meta.voiceoverRule: One line, said or used as the caption. No prices, no ranking claims, never “photo”.
_meta.imageNote: D12: final videos are rendered only from final illustrations. Placeholders are for timing tests only.
